triples.subject: nginx logs
triples.source_text: To rotate the nginx logs on the web host

triples.subject: service
triples.source_text: first stop the service with `systemctl stop nginx`

triples.subject: current logs
triples.source_text: Then archive the current logs: `tar -czf /backup/nginx-logs-$(date +%F).tar.gz /var/log/nginx`

triples.subject: log directory
triples.source_text: After the archive is written, clear the log directory with `rm /var/log/nginx/*.log`

triples.subject: service
triples.source_text: and start the service again using `systemctl start nginx`
